questions.text: The probability that two friends are born in the same month is ____ ?
questions.solution:
Whatever month the first friend is born in, the second matches it with probability 1/12.

Answer: 1/12

questions.text: The number of bit strings of length 8 that will either start with 1 or end with 00 is?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Start with 1: [latex]2^7=128[/latex]
- End with 00: [latex]2^6=64[/latex]
- Both: [latex]2^5=32[/latex]

128 + 64 [latex]-[/latex] 32 = 160

Answer: 160

questions.text: The CORECT formula for the sentence, "not all rainy days are cold" is
questions.solution:
"Not all rainy days are cold" = there is a rainy day that is not cold.

[latex]\neg\forall d(Rainy(d)\rightarrow Cold(d))\equiv\exists d(Rainy(d)\wedge\sim Cold(d))[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\exists d(Rainy(d)\wedge\sim Cold(d))[/latex]

questions.text: Let [latex]\delta[/latex] denote the minimum degree of a vertex in a graph. For all planar graphs on n vertices with [latex]\delta \geq 3[/latex], which one of the following is TRUE?
questions.solution:
[latex]\delta\ge3\Rightarrow 2e=\sum\deg\ge3n\Rightarrow e\ge\frac{3n}{2}[/latex]

Euler: [latex]f=e-n+2\ge\frac{3n}{2}-n+2=\frac n2+2[/latex], for every planar embedding.

Answer: In any planar embedding, the number of faces is at least [latex]\frac n2+2[/latex]

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: In any planar embedding, the number of faces is at least [latex]\frac{n}{2}+2[/latex]
In any planar embedding, the number of faces is less than [latex]\frac{n}{2}+2[/latex]
There is a planar embedding in which the number of faces is less than [latex]\frac{n}{2}+2[/latex]
There is a planar embedding in which the number of faces is at most [latex]\frac{n}{\delta +1}[/latex]

questions.text: If G is a forest with n vertices and k connected components, how many edges does G have?
questions.solution:
Each tree with [latex]n_i[/latex] vertices has [latex]n_i-1[/latex] edges. Summing over k trees: [latex]\sum(n_i-1)=n-k[/latex].

Answer: n [latex]-[/latex] k
